authority: descriptive audit only; no qualified model, SIM cache or historical source replacement

methods.collector: receiver_specialist_review.review; unchanged source and index revalidation
methods.field: entry-weighted resolved indexed entries, including winners and missing ranks for usage
methods.winners: all observed rank-one usernames including ties, complete indexed portfolios only
methods.peers: same contest and exact indexed entry count; all current winners excluded; equal-user mean; five/ten support
methods.gaps: within-contest winner mean minus field usage or size-matched peer mean, contests averaged within game, games equally
methods.finish: ranked resolved entries; exact Captain and salary band overlap; five/ten entries per side
methods.later_window: outcome-selected current winners, NOT the prior-qualified held-out cohort; not prospective validation
